name: The Treasure Vault
riddle: Wake not the keeper, feed it instead; give it the pearl from the oyster bed.

steps.objective: Find the pearl from the oyster bed.

hints: The keeper sleeps before the great chest. Waking it would be a mistake; a gift might not.
Oysters grow where fresh water falls. Grip one and it opens.
Hold what you found to the keeper's mouth. Then all hands on the lid at once!

reward.nextRiddle: The treasure is found. Fair winds, crew!
